FINAL LANDSCAPE WORKS
Greenline delivered 40 concrete pavers and 12 bags of planting soil, completed paver laying, and trimmed the existing acacia trees for one PHP 76,000 package. Paver laying applies only to the concrete pavers; the soil was handed over loose. Tree trimming concerns existing trees and is not installation of either purchased material.

Weekend delivery included. Replacement of cracked pavers within seven days; watering follow-up is still pending.

human_approval.rationale: Partial relationship and mixed non-installation service draft awaiting human review.
